about: Put by esv::swap_places::RequestSystem on the helper entity it creates for a batch of swap-places requests (the same entity gets esv::swap_places::RequestOneFrameComponent and a 0x18-element request array component); counts down 4 seconds, then the entity is destroyed. Creator bg3.exe+0x2E9F3F0 (called from bg3.exe+0x2E9E370 = ProcessSwapPlacesRequests); countdown in bg3.exe+0x2E9F130 (third step of the per-frame update bg3.exe+0x2E9DEF0; Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x5D7810 RequestSystem::CleanupSwapPlacesRequests does the same). No savegame model.

evidence.says: bg3.exe+0x2E9F3F0: AllocRaw(0x10), then copies to +0 the value its second argument points to, the same handle that is the key of the component's entity map (bg3.exe+0x77E0C0, called with the entity) - the entity the component is added to (created by bg3.exe+0x401AFF0 in bg3.exe+0x2E9E370). macOS default constructor stores a 16-byte constant at +0 then 4.0f at +8 (null handle default, hint only).

bg3.exe+0x2E9F3F0 writes 0x40800000 (4.0f); bg3.exe+0x2E9F130 line 141 subtracts the float at +8 of the game time from the float at +8 of the component; when the result is 0 or less the entity is destroyed (Toolkit CleanupSwapPlacesRequests the same).
Not written by the creator (AllocRaw memory, only +0 and +8 stored); alignment padding to 16.

survey.live_reason: no live or captured instance: needs a situation that creates it
open_questions: Whether +0 is really meant as a self handle or some other entity that happens to equal it at creation (only caller passes the new entity).
